prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Decision support frameworks for precision irrigation have been evaluated for applicability to Pannonian Plain conditions, with a gap analysis identifying limited availability of locally validated crop coefficient databases and absence of standardised sensor calibration protocols for Vojvodina's diverse soil types as key barriers to adoption.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07499","field":"abstract","quote":"Decision support frameworks are evaluated across three categories: threshold-based scheduling, model-driven scheduling, and machine learning-assisted forecasting"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-07499","field":"abstract","quote":"limited availability of locally validated crop coefficient databases and the absence of standardised sensor calibration protocols for Vojvodina's diverse soil types as key barriers to adoption"}]}]}
